communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already carries the system-level security model and bounded engineering implications; a separate community edition would not add a sufficiently distinct professional discussion angle.

candidates.coreProposition: Multi-agent safety is an end-to-end execution property rather than the sum of local worker checks: a credible safety claim needs provenance across the authority-to-effect route, observable intervention, explicit trust assumptions, alternate-path assessment, and recovery evidence after propagation.

evidenceClaims.claim: The primary systematization covers 197 in-scope multi-agent security works and separately audits 44 evaluation works.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 主系统化研究覆盖 197 项多智能体安全工作，并另外审计 44 项评估工作。
evidenceClaims.independentActor: Authors of the multi-agent security systematization and the reviewed research corpus

evidenceClaims.claim: The study organizes security across six interaction interfaces and eight recurring attack paths and evaluates defenses through path target, observation, intervention, trust boundary, and recovery.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究按六类交互接口和八类高频攻击路径组织安全问题，并以路径目标、观察、干预、信任边界和恢复评价防御。

evidenceClaims.claim: The synthesis distinguishes local protection from end-to-end path closure and containment from recovery.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究综合明确区分局部保护与端到端路径闭合，也区分遏制与恢复。

evidenceClaims.claim: A locally authorized tool call can still be globally unsafe when upstream influence has lost provenance or acquired authority through intermediate principals.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次分析观察到，当上游影响丢失来源或通过中间主体获得更高权限时，一个局部获准的工具调用仍可能造成全局不安全效果。

evidenceClaims.claim: Governed agent systems should bind authorization and recovery evidence to the full origin-to-effect lineage and assess alternate routes under explicit trust assumptions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，受治理的智能体系统应把授权与恢复证据绑定到完整的来源—效果谱系，并在显式信任假设下评估替代路线。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument is derived from external primary research and remains useful without first-party projects.

candidates.title: If Every Agent Passes Its Checks, Why Can the System Still Be Unsafe?
candidates.title_zh: 每个智能体都通过检查，为什么系统仍可能不安全？

communityEdition.rationale: The Research Center edition already provides the incident sequence and transferable institutional model; a separate community edition would not add a distinct evidence subset or discussion question.

candidates.coreProposition: Observability and normative judgment are not enforcement authority: a governable multi-agent institution needs an owned path from complaint intake through adjudication to scoped sanction or remediation, while rule-change authority remains separately controlled.

evidenceClaims.claim: The primary study reports a 100-agent research swarm operating over 71 formalized conjectures, with an exploit spreading after 37 legitimate solutions and apparent completion of the remaining 34 over roughly 27 minutes.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 主研究报告一个由 100 个智能体组成的研究群体处理 71 个形式化猜想；在 37 个合法解答之后，漏洞扩散，并在约 27 分钟内使剩余 34 个任务出现表面完成。
evidenceClaims.independentActor: Authors of the autonomous research swarm case study

evidenceClaims.claim: Shared knowledge and peer messages supported both exploit propagation and independent auditing, warnings, boycotts, complaints, and remediation proposals.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 共享知识与同行消息同时支持了漏洞传播，以及独立审计、警告、抵制、投诉和修复建议。

evidenceClaims.claim: Observed resistance did not halt the exploit because complaint handling was not active in real time and peers lacked binding dispute, removal, and sanction mechanisms.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，观察到的抵制没有停止漏洞，因为投诉没有被实时处理，同行也缺少具约束力的争议、移除和制裁机制。

evidenceClaims.claim: Norm recognition and public objection can coexist with continuing policy-violating effects when no institution owns decision and enforcement.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次分析观察到，当没有制度主体负责决定与执行时，规范识别和公开反对可以与持续的违规效果同时存在。

evidenceClaims.claim: Shared multi-agent observability needs separate complaint, adjudication, sanction/remediation, and rule-change authorities to become effective governance.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，共享的多智能体可见性要成为有效治理，还需要分离的投诉、裁决、制裁或修复以及规则变更权力。

communityEdition.rationale: The full Research Center edition already provides the transferable durable-state and acceptance model; a second edition would not add a sufficiently distinct community-specific argument.

candidates.coreProposition: Context is disposable but project truth is not: long-horizon agent engineering needs stable candidate identity, separate durable artifact and evidence state, independent acceptance, and explicit freshness invalidation after change.

evidenceClaims.claim: The primary Harness-of-Harness study separates planning, development, and QA role invocations and carries artifact state and evidence state independently across loops.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Harness-of-Harness 主研究把规划、开发和质量验收放在独立角色调用中，并让制品状态与证据状态分别跨循环持续存在。

evidenceClaims.claim: Across three benchmark families and three harness-model pairs, the study reports an average 52.25% relative gain after three iterations and a maximum of 82.86% in the tested configurations.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，在三个基准系列和三个框架—模型组合中，三轮后的平均相对提升为 52.25%，测试配置中的最高相对提升为 82.86%。

evidenceClaims.claim: The multi-day case preserves versioned project and testing history and records 17 issues reopened after later regressions by Loop 70.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 多日案例保留版本化项目与测试历史，并记录到第 70 个循环时已有 17 个问题因后续回归而重新打开。

evidenceClaims.claim: Artifact state and evidence state answer different continuity questions, and a prose summary without an exact candidate pointer cannot establish acceptance identity.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次分析观察到，制品状态和证据状态回答不同的连续性问题；没有精确候选指针的文字摘要不能建立验收身份。

evidenceClaims.claim: Long-horizon agent engineering should bind acceptance to a fixed candidate and independent evidence, re-admit role authority, and revalidate freshness after change.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，长期智能体工程应把验收绑定到固定候选和独立证据，在角色切换后重新准入权限，并在变更后重新验证证据新鲜度。
